capabilities: display a minimap alongside canvas notes
navigate the canvas by clicking a position on the minimap
toggle the minimap via command palette or settings
extras: README warns that Obsidian has no public API for canvas access, so the plugin uses a workaround that may break in future updates.
intentEvidence: This plugin provides a minimap for canvas notes, which can help you navigate and get an overview
problem: As canvas notes grow, it becomes hard to navigate them and easy to get lost, and Obsidian offers no overview tool for canvases.
summary: Adds a minimap to Obsidian canvas notes for navigating and getting an overview of large canvases.
